colors.primary_description: Harvard Crimson. Use for major highlights, buttons, and the AI chatbot orb.
colors.secondary_description: Obsidian Black. Use for stark contrast in dark-mode sections (Agent Profile) and heavy text.
colors.accent_description: Metallic Gold. Use sparingly for premium accents, fine borders, and special hover states.
colors.background_light_description: Crisp Off-White. Main page background to let the red and photos pop.
colors.background_dark_description: Deep Charcoal/Black. For footer and agent profile section to create cinematic contrast.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Museum Exhibition / Editorial Magazine. Massive negative space. Heavy asymmetry.
layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Bento Grid Mode A (Tetris Grid) for photo galleries. Strict asymmetrical columns for text.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius_explanation: Zero rounding. Sharp edges to maintain architectural precision and luxury feel. No soft corners.

buttons.primary: bg-[#A51C30] text-white hover:bg-[#8A1527] transition-colors duration-300 rounded-none px-8 py-4 font-bold tracking-widest text-sm uppercase
buttons.linkedin: bg-[#0A0A0A] text-[#D4AF37] hover:bg-[#1A1A1A] border border-[#D4AF37]/30 transition-all duration-300 rounded-none px-8 py-4 flex items-center gap-3 font-bold uppercase text-sm

cards.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border border-white/40 shadow-sm (Light mode) or backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 border border-white/10 (Dark mode)

chatbot.trigger: fixed bottom-8 right-8 w-16 h-16 bg-[#A51C30] text-white rounded-full flex items-center justify-center shadow-2xl hover:scale-105 transition-transform cursor-pointer z-50
chatbot.window: fixed bottom-28 right-8 w-80 md:w-96 backdrop-blur-2xl bg-white/90 border border-[#A51C30]/20 shadow-2xl p-0 flex flex-col overflow-hidden z-50

hero.layout: Minimum 90vh height. Asymmetrical split or massive overlapping text.
hero.visuals: Hero exterior image taking up 70% of the screen width on the right. Large Cormorant Garamond typography overlapping on the left.
hero.overlay: Subtle linear gradient from black/40 to transparent to ensure text readability.

property_details.layout: Bento Grid for specs (3-bed, 2.5-bath, 1142 sqft, $950k). Stark white background with crisp typography and red accent lines.

photo_gallery.layout: Masonry or Bento Mode A grid. Images should touch (gap-1 or gap-0) or have massive architectural gaps (gap-8).
photo_gallery.hover_effect: Images grayscale by default, fade to full color on hover.

drone_footage.visuals: Cinematic 16:9 black box with gold pulsing text. Credit: 'Drone footage by Leon Mansalud @ayeleon' in tiny tracked-out caps below.

agent_profile.visuals: Agent headshot on the left, bio on the right. High contrast white and gold text on black. Prominent LinkedIn DM button.

images.description: Contemporary architecture exterior for the hero section.
Vaulted ceiling living room, modern luxury.
Modern kitchen with granite countertops and stainless steel appliances.
Professional confident man in suit representing agent George Toscano.

testing.rules: All interactive elements must include a data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case and role-based.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the #A51C30 Harvard Crimson color for primary CTAs and accents. Avoid maroon.
Use sharp, rounded-none edges on buttons, cards, and images to create an architectural, luxury feel.
Implement the AI chatbot as a floating widget. The chat window should use the 'glassmorphism' card style.
The drone footage section should be a highly aesthetic 'Coming Soon' placeholder featuring a black cinematic container with gold text and the required Leon Mansalud credit.
The LinkedIn Contact button should be prominently placed in the hero section and the Agent Profile section.
Install and configure 'lucide-react' for crisp iconography.
Ensure headings use Cormorant Garamond (add to Google Fonts import) and body uses Outfit.
All components must be mobile-first. Follow Charlotte Software Engineering standards (clean code, standard tools, visually striking).
